children: Swaminathan previously held finance leadership roles at Rallis India, Can-Pack India and Syngenta
Tata Chemicals has appointed Bhaskar Swaminathan as Head of Enterprise Business Finance. He announced his new role in a LinkedIn post on November 12, 2026.
Swaminathan joins the company after serving as Chief Financial Officer (CFO) of Rallis India, a Tata Group company, from August 2025 to October 2026.
He has previously worked at Tata Chemicals for nearly five years, holding roles including Head of India Business Finance and Business Controller for the Performance Materials business unit.
Before rejoining Tata Chemicals, Swaminathan served as CFO of Rallis India. Earlier, he was Chief Finance Officer at Can-Pack India from July 2018 to February 2019.
He also worked at Syngenta as APAC Head of the Procure-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash processes from April 2017 to July 2018.

His professional experience spans financial planning, business planning, internal audit, accounting, taxation, customs, initial public offering (IPO) processes, mergers and acquisitions (M&A), shared services and fundraising. He has worked across sectors including hospitality, optical fibre manufacturing, automobiles, auto components, engineering goods and agrochemicals.

Swaminathan is a Chartered Accountant from the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI), having completed the qualification in 1995. He graduated from Vivekananda College, Mylapore, Chennai, with a Bachelor of Commerce degree in 1991.
